svg.title: Flowgent | Physical Call Architecture
svg.desc: Flowgent architecture with four responsibility zones: Browser and Application UI, AuthGuard access control, Flowgent orchestration, and AgentVault payment integration. Payee SDKs intercept inbound collection requests at A2A and generated MCP servers. The Payer SDK intercepts outbound A2A and MCP payment requests. Dagger marks integration work that has not shipped.
svg.text: Solid: service calls / Dashed: resource control / Dotted: state or files / † Planned integration
SDK attachment points; AgentVault remains a separate service
Handle payment challenge, proof and retry
Paid requests carry AgentVault payment proof
One backend image · application / session runtimes
Lifecycle events · ExecutionPlan / TaskResult · notifications · Sandbox tasks†
All protected APIs route through Envoy
UI: User Interface | API: Application Programming Interface | CRUD: Create, Read, Update, Delete | DAG: Directed Acyclic Graph | LLM: Large Language Model
A2A: Agent-to-Agent | MCP: Model Context Protocol | SDK: Software Development Kit | REST: Representational State Transfer
MQTT: Message Queuing Telemetry Transport | SQL: Structured Query Language | HTTP: Hypertext Transfer Protocol | JM / TM: JobManager / TaskManager
† Planned: Payee/Payer SDKs, the generated MCP endpoint and fixed Sandbox pools. Current code retains legacy signing and JM-owned Sandbox workers.
SDKs run in Flowgent endpoints or clients. All protected HTTP calls reuse Envoy routes; SDK service arrows omit that repeated gateway hop.
Runtime business state goes through API Server. A2A task storage and coordination locks are narrow exceptions; :9990 remains private.
